versions.content: If development error detection for TtcanIf is enabled: The function CanIf_TTGetControllerTime() shall raise the error CANIF_E_PARAM_- POINTER and shall return E_NOT_OK if one of the parameter CanIf_TTCycle- Count , CanIf_TTGlobalTime , CanIf_TTLocalTime and CanIf_TTCycleTime is a NULL pointer.
